nodes.name: test_frontend_guards.py
nodes.summary: Offline guards for the frontend shell, chat renderer, citations, and controller, plus a stub-only Chrome run of send, retry, and upload failures. View scripts are forbidden from calling the backend or injecting HTML.
nodes.languageNotes: Static checks use the standard library. The citation and stage-4 fixtures launch headless Chrome and skip, rather than fail, when Chrome or the CDN libraries are missing.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Reads a path under frontend/ as UTF-8 text for the static guard assertions.

nodes.name: test_entrypoints_exist
nodes.summary: Checks that frontend/js/app.js, frontend/css/main.css, and the Lucide license file are present.

nodes.name: test_view_files_do_not_call_backend
nodes.summary: Checks that view scripts never call fetch, API, or State and never use eval, document.write, or new Function.

nodes.name: test_no_inline_handlers_or_styles_in_markup
nodes.summary: Checks that index.html has no inline event handlers and that the only inline style is display:none on the stop button.

nodes.name: test_no_new_external_origins
nodes.summary: Checks that first-party HTML, CSS, and JS reference only the allow-listed font and CDN origins, ignoring the vendored directory.

nodes.name: test_app_js_ids_exist_in_index
nodes.summary: Checks that every getElementById target in app.js is an id present in index.html.

nodes.name: test_sprite_references_resolve
nodes.summary: Checks that every icon used in markup or via Icons.html and Icons.el has a matching symbol in the index.html sprite.

nodes.name: test_no_hex_colors_outside_token_files
nodes.summary: Checks that components.css and animations.css contain no raw hex colors.

nodes.name: test_reduced_motion_rule_present
nodes.summary: Checks that animations.css contains a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule.

nodes.name: test_no_right_sidebar_region
nodes.summary: Checks that index.html does not define a right sidebar or right panel region.

nodes.name: test_buttons_have_accessible_name
nodes.summary: Parses index.html and checks that every button has visible text, an aria-label, aria-labelledby, or a title.

nodes.name: test_index_ids_are_unique
nodes.summary: Checks that id attributes in index.html are unique.

nodes.name: test_ui_ids_exist_in_index_or_are_created_dynamically
nodes.summary: Checks that ids looked up by ui.js and model-select.js exist in index.html, except modelTrigger which the component creates.

nodes.name: test_model_select_never_uses_html_injection
nodes.summary: Checks that model-select.js never assigns innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, or document.write.

nodes.name: test_session_list_interpolations_are_escaped
nodes.summary: Checks that renderSessionList interpolations are escaped or on a reviewed allow-list, including title and session id.

nodes.name: test_file_accept_matches_controller_allow_list
nodes.summary: Checks that the file input accept attribute lists the same extensions as ALLOWED in app.js.

nodes.name: test_welcome_cards_and_mode_dropdown_are_consistent
nodes.summary: Checks that welcome cards cover the same four modes as the ui.js dropdown, that their names describe a switch-and-fill action, and that workspace prompts never send.

nodes.name: test_no_unverifiable_marketing_claims
nodes.summary: Checks that index.html and ui.js do not claim the product is free, fully private, encrypted, unlimited, or the fastest.

nodes.name: test_shell_breakpoints_match_between_head_snippet_and_ui
nodes.summary: Checks that the 768px and 1024px width checks in index.html match the 767px and 1023px media queries in ui.js.

nodes.name: test_sidebar_toggle_controls_existing_region
nodes.summary: Checks that the sidebar toggle's aria-controls target exists and that the toggle starts aria-expanded false.

nodes.name: test_sidebar_is_hidden_from_tab_order_when_closed_drawer
nodes.summary: Checks that closed-drawer styles use visibility:hidden and that ui.js sets the sidebar inert.

nodes.name: test_coarse_pointer_targets_are_44px
nodes.summary: Checks that a pointer: coarse media query exists and that the shell styles include a 44px target size.

nodes.name: test_model_select_keeps_native_select_as_source_of_truth
nodes.summary: Checks that the custom listbox updates the native select, exposes listbox ARIA, and refuses a no-op or disabled choice.

nodes.name: _css_rules
nodes.summary: Yields selector and body pairs for simple CSS rules, including rules nested in @media, whose selector matches a pattern.

nodes.name: test_feature_card_try_line_is_never_hidden
nodes.summary: Checks that .feature-card__try rules never use display:none, visibility:hidden, or height:0.

nodes.name: test_feature_card_border_uses_control_token
nodes.summary: Checks that .welcome__starter borders use var(--border-control) and do not fall back to var(--border).

nodes.name: _fn_body
nodes.summary: Returns the brace body of a named function in a JavaScript source string and fails the test when that function is missing. This definition replaces an earlier helper of the same name.

nodes.name: test_sources_block_never_uses_html_injection
nodes.summary: Checks that chat.js _fillSources writes text only, builds links with Utils.safeUrl, and sets noopener noreferrer on new tabs.

nodes.name: test_every_blank_target_has_noopener_noreferrer
nodes.summary: Checks that every _blank target in chat.js, ui.js, utils.js, and index.html is paired with rel="noopener".

nodes.name: test_chat_innerhtml_templates_interpolate_only_safe_values
nodes.summary: Checks that chat.js innerHTML templates interpolate only escaped or static values and that badge text goes through Utils.escapeHtml.

nodes.name: test_renderer_and_chat_api_used_by_app_js_still_exists
nodes.summary: Checks that every renderer and Chat method called from app.js is still defined in chat.js, including markPartial and setVizState.

nodes.name: test_ai_viz_is_css_only_and_decorative
nodes.summary: Checks that the AI visualization is aria-hidden, uses no timers or random motion in script, and animates only through tokenized CSS.

nodes.name: test_ai_viz_reduced_motion_and_hidden_tab_rules
nodes.summary: Checks that ai-viz.css disables animation under reduced motion, pauses it when the page is hidden, and keyframes only transform and opacity.

nodes.name: test_no_interval_timers_or_raf_loops_in_frontend
nodes.summary: Checks that no frontend script uses setInterval and that chat.js calls requestAnimationFrame at most twice.

nodes.name: test_streaming_does_not_announce_per_token
nodes.summary: Checks that appendToken does not announce each token and that token rendering stays throttled to 60ms.

nodes.name: test_stage3_ids_exist
nodes.summary: Checks that the welcome visualization, jump-latest, live status, and chat area ids exist and that chat.js element lookups resolve.

nodes.name: test_sanitizer_policy_forbids_class_role_download_ping_in_utils
nodes.summary: Checks that the utils.js sanitizer FORBID_ATTR list includes class, role, download, and ping.

nodes.name: test_citation_label_falls_back_to_source_n_and_is_used_everywhere
nodes.summary: Checks that a blank citation title becomes "Source N" and that both citation dialogs go through _citationLabel.

nodes.name: test_citation_ids_resolved_once_for_stream_and_history_paths
nodes.summary: Checks that stream and history citations are resolved once and that _resolveCitations copies objects instead of mutating the input.

nodes.name: test_coarse_pointer_citation_hit_area_rule_present_and_scoped
nodes.summary: Checks that coarse pointers get a 44px absolutely positioned hit area on citation buttons without changing the visual badge.

nodes.name: cite_result
nodes.summary: Runs chat.js, utils.js, and icons.js in headless Chrome with citation fixtures and returns the JSON the harness writes, skipping when Chrome or the CDN libraries are missing.

nodes.name: _id_list
nodes.summary: Returns the citation id column for one named case in the browser citation result.

nodes.name: test_browser_citation_ids_consistent_unique_and_input_not_mutated
nodes.summary: Asserts citation ids stay unique across missing, explicit, duplicate, and invalid inputs and that the source array is not mutated.

nodes.name: test_browser_blank_citations_get_accessible_source_n_names
nodes.summary: Asserts blank citations are named Source 1, Source 2, and Source 3, a javascript: URL is not linked, and the dialog title matches the row.

nodes.name: test_browser_isolated_badge_reaches_44px_on_coarse_pointers
nodes.summary: Asserts an isolated citation badge stays visually small while its coarse-pointer hit target is at least 44 by 44 pixels.

nodes.name: test_browser_multi_citation_sentence_badges_reach_44px_wide
nodes.summary: Asserts adjacent citation badges in one sentence each have a coarse-pointer hit area at least 44 by 44 pixels.

nodes.name: _code
nodes.summary: Strips block comments and line comments from a source string so later assertions do not match commented-out code.

nodes.name: _app_fn
nodes.summary: Returns the body of a top-level function in app.js, from its opening brace up to the next sibling function.

nodes.name: test_app_js_has_no_native_confirm_inline_color_interval_or_emoji
nodes.summary: Checks that app.js uses UI.confirm four times and does not call window.confirm, set inline colors, use setInterval, or embed emoji.

nodes.name: test_welcome_card_handler_never_sends
nodes.summary: Checks that the welcome-card handler, file picker, and composer filler only switch mode and fill text, and that ui.js does not send from those cards.

nodes.name: test_allowed_extensions_include_rst_and_match_accept_and_backend
nodes.summary: Checks that app.js allows .rst and that the accept attribute, the client allow-list, and parser.SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS are the same set.

nodes.name: test_request_payload_shapes_match_the_backend_contract
nodes.summary: Checks that chat and session payloads in app.js and api.js match ChatRequest and the session body fields in the backend models.

nodes.name: test_regenerate_and_retry_send_the_head_shape
nodes.summary: Checks that regenerate and the retry helper send message as an empty string and pass regenerate through _onSend.

nodes.name: test_composer_is_cleared_only_after_the_server_accepted
nodes.summary: Checks that the composer is cleared inside the onAccepted callback, which runs only after api.js has seen a successful response.

nodes.name: test_no_new_timer_or_listener_patterns_in_controller
nodes.summary: Checks that app.js has a single setTimeout, clears the cooldown timer, and never writes HTML.

nodes.name: stub_run
nodes.summary: Serves the frontend on a GET-only port, injects the shared fetch stub and stage-4 scenario, and returns the JSON from headless Chrome.

nodes.name: test_stub_nothing_reached_a_server
nodes.summary: Asserts the stage-4 browser run served only static GETs and recorded no page errors.

nodes.name: test_stub_welcome_cards_never_submit_and_fill_the_composer
nodes.summary: Asserts each welcome card fills the composer with its prompt, focuses the input, and never POSTs.

nodes.name: test_stub_failures_before_accept_keep_the_draft_and_add_no_bubble
nodes.summary: Asserts session-create and HTTP failures before accept keep the draft, add no bubbles, and that a 429 cooldown blocks then allows one later send.

nodes.name: test_stub_stream_error_restores_draft_and_never_duplicates_the_user_bubble
nodes.summary: Asserts a stream error keeps one user bubble and that both resend and retry regenerate with an empty message.

nodes.name: test_stub_failed_regenerate_keeps_the_previous_answer
nodes.summary: Asserts a failed regenerate leaves the previous answer in place and sends regenerate with an empty message.

nodes.name: test_stub_upload_failure_retry_resends_the_same_file
nodes.summary: Asserts a failed upload can be retried with the same notes.rst file and that .exe and extensionless names are never posted.
